verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents vault health reports, including Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords reports run locally on the client, which covers the weak and reused parts of the story. The evidence describes on-demand reports rather than proactive warnings, and it never mentions breached-service or exposed-password detection. Missing for 10: evidence of breach/exposed-credential reporting, proactive alerting rather than manually run reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Reports, such as the Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords report, are run locally on your client
Vault health reports can help you evaluate the security of your Bitwarden individual or organization vault
